sections.heading: Overview
bullets: Wing 7's capstone fight, built around defending pylons from Qadim the Peerless and his adds. One of the harder DPS/coordination checks in the raid roster.

sections.heading: Pylons & breakbar
bullets: Qadim the Peerless repeatedly tries to capture pylons — breaking his defiance bar triggers Havoc Break, stunning him and stopping the capture attempt.

Entropic Distortion adds can also charge at pylons — stopping them (the "Power Surge" achievement condition) is worth tracking even outside of achievement runs, since a captured pylon hurts the squad.

sections.heading: Chaos damage
bullets: Multiple attacks apply chaos-based damage and effects like Chaos Corrosion, including persistent damage fields — don't stand in lingering chaos zones.

sections.heading: Notes
bullets: We haven't pinned down a full elemental phase breakdown or enrage timer for this one yet — treat it as a coordination-heavy fight and lean on your commander's callouts until this page gets a fuller pass.
